title: Come From Away - Phoenix Theatre - review ★★★★★
transcript: come from way a musical byron sank off and david hein directed by chrystopher ashley of the Phoenix Theatre in London 9/11 was a tragic event carried out by evil people the musical come from away is a kind of antidote reminding us that most people are basically good and generous to each other I've forgotten but at the time of the 9/11 attacks US airspace was closed which meant hundreds of planes were diverted 35 of them with 7,000 people on board ended up in a small Canadian community called Gander doubling the population now the locals could have been hostile to these unexpected immigrants but instead they welcomed them and looked after them and in this musical we meet a diverse number of characters locals passengers and crew telling us their true story we get a sense of the panic and fears of the time and then we Zone in on some of the individual stories and how they are changed by their experience it's not all sugar-coated there is some anti-muslim behavior for example and some tragedy of course but the overriding message is one of hope I was impressed by the use of an almost bare stage a few chairs and tables become a plane a bus a cafe a community hall it puts the burden on the cast to create the scenes in our imagination but this is a talented cast who take on many parts it's theater and acting at its purest they're all really good but I'm going to be unfair and pick out Mary dougherty as the pilot who loves flying that has to take charge on the ground and Kat Simmons as Hannah worried about her firefighter son in New York there could be more light and shade there are many funny bits and there's a love story but I would have liked to dwell a little bit more on the moments of sadness however the pace is tremendous and you really don't have time to think about that and the ending which is akin to a hoedown is entertaining and hugely uplifting this musical quite possibly paints too rosy a picture but I think right now we should treasure this positive view of humanity I give come from away four stars if you found this review interesting useful please subscribe to my youtube channel one minute theater views by clicking on the icon you know
